description: Write ad hooks grounded in a completed search's quotes, using BuzzSearch's hook writer: each hook opens with a callout lifted from real comments and carries a loop or promise. Metered at the API rate, no new search. Works on searches started through the API or MCP. Give an `angle` to steer (a product, a persona, a platform).

angle.description: Optional steer, e.g. 'TikTok UGC for a $40 posture corrector'.

search_id.description: The search id returned by `search` or `list_searches`.

wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait server-side for completion before returning (0 to 55). Call again to resume.

name: generate_hooks
title: Generate ad hooks
